name: centry-ifici
description:
Explore Portugal’s IFICI regime, sometimes called NHR 2.0, in your ChatGPT conversation. Understand the residence-history, work-route and registration conditions; compare illustrative 2026 mainland basic income tax at ordinary rates and the 20% IFICI rate on the same net taxable Portuguese employment or self-employment income.

Ask whether IFICI could apply when moving to Portugal, what must be checked about your role and employer, or how a qualifying work-income scenario compares with ordinary IRS. ChatGPT can gather the relevant details and explain the result in the conversation. An interactive calculator is also available when useful.

Uses linked Portuguese Tax Authority sources and explicit assumptions. Eligibility is preliminary and never confirmed by the calculator. Numerical comparisons exclude tax credits, minimum-existence relief, solidarity surcharge, social security, joint assessment and other income; they are not final tax bills or take-home pay estimates. The calculator does not estimate foreign-income or pension exemptions, provide visa or investment advice, file tax returns, or submit IFICI applications.

No email, tax number or identity document is needed. If you choose professional review, you can request Centry’s introductory consultation link. The plugin does not book a time or send your calculation inputs to the calendar.

defaultPrompt: Could I qualify for Portugal’s IFICI or NHR 2.0 regime?
Compare IFICI with ordinary Portuguese income tax for my taxable work income.
What must I check about my job and employer for IFICI?

positive.prompt: Open Centry's IFICI calculator so I can explore a move to Portugal.
positive.expected_behavior: Open interactive calculator with no invented income or eligibility facts and no booking gate.

positive.prompt: Compare IFICI for EUR 80,000 annual net taxable Portuguese work income. First resident 2026, no residence in the prior five years, neither NHR nor Regressar, a potential qualifying activity and entity route, mainland, no other income.
positive.expected_behavior: Ordinary basic IRS 27238.28, IFICI 16000, difference 11238.28; eligibility not confirmed, exclusions and sources shown.
positive.description: Compare a complete mainland work-income scenario

positive.prompt: Compare IFICI for EUR 80,000 annual net taxable Portuguese work income. First resident 2026, no Portuguese residence in the previous five years, previously benefited from NHR, potential qualifying activity and entity route, mainland, no other income.
positive.expected_behavior: Flag previous NHR exclusion and suppress an IFICI saving. Never portray an NHR rollover.

positive.prompt: What are the IFICI eligibility and registration conditions?
positive.expected_behavior: Bounded source-linked information with activity/entity conditions, exclusions and registration caveats.

positive.prompt: I would like an introductory call with Centry to discuss this IFICI estimate.
positive.expected_behavior: Return first-party consultation page; do not book, charge or transmit inputs. Do not claim booking confirmed.

negative.prompt: Book me a restaurant table in Lisbon.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke the Centry IFICI tools.

negative.prompt: File my Portuguese tax return using my tax number and Financas password.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not collect identifiers or credentials or attempt filing through this plugin.

negative.prompt: Automatically transfer my pension into crypto and invest it to qualify for IFICI.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not execute investments or claim that investment alone qualifies for IFICI.

review.commerce_description: No products, subscriptions or services are purchased through the plugin. An optional external link opens Centry’s introductory consultation page. This handoff is disclosed for policy review; no booking or payment is made by the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial Vercel-hosted release of the Centry IFICI Calculator. Explore IFICI eligibility conditions and illustrative 2026 mainland Portuguese work-income tax comparisons in ChatGPT, with an optional interactive calculator and consultation link. Includes explicit assumptions, exclusions and linked official sources. No separate Centry account, booking or payment is required. Operated by Centry Cognitive Capital Pte. Ltd. (Singapore).
